blind.description: A small black cylindrical candle with textured wax drips down the sides and a central wick, resting in a small circular dish or candle holder with a raised lip. Surfaces are solid and continuous, standing flat on the floor via the base of the dish. No active flame or glow.
blind.from_above: Concentric circles formed by the outer circular dish and the candle top, with a small central wick dot and a shadow cast to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 6 to 8 inches tall (roughly 1/10th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and 5 to 6 inches wide at the saucer base.

notes: Height is somewhat squatter than catalog ratio due to wider saucer base
